title: Independent: Card Row
prompt:
Build a responsive-ish card row with flex:

- `.row` is a flex container whose items wrap when space runs out, with a `1rem` gap.
- Each `.card` has `flex: 1` and a minimum width of `200px` (hint: flex-basis or min-width) so cards can't shrink into slivers.
- All three cards end up the same width on wide screens (flex handles it).
boilerplate:
One
Two
Three

tests.name: row wraps with gap
cards share space with a floor
tests.hint: .card { flex: 1; min-width: 200px; } — equal share, never thinner than 200px.
